pairs: And now they add that they will be sinning more.
feceruntque sibi conflatile de argento suo quasi similitudinem idolorum:
And they have made themselves an image cast from their silver, just like the image of idols;
but the whole thing has been made by craftsmen.
For this reason, they will be like the morning clouds,
et sicut ros matutinus præteriens; sicut pulvis turbine raptus ex area,
and like the morning dew that passes away, just like the dust that is driven by a whirlwind away from the threshing floor,
and like the smoke from a chimney.
Ego autem Dominus Deus tuus, ex terra Ægypti;
But I am the Lord your God from the land of Egypt,
and you will not know God apart from me,
et salvator non est præter me.
and there is no Savior except me.
I knew you in the desert,
they have been filled up and have been satisfied.
And they have lifted up their heart,
Et ego ero eis quasi leæna,
And I will be to them like a lioness,
like a leopard in the way of the Assyrians.
Occurram eis quasi ursa raptis catulis,
I will run to meet them like a bear that has been robbed of her young,
and I will split open the middle of their liver.
et consumam eos ibi quasi leo:
And I will devour them there like a lion;
the beast of the field will tear them apart.
Your help is only in me.
maxime nunc salvet te in omnibus urbibus tuis;
Now, especially, let him save you in all your cities,
Dabo tibi regem in furore meo,
I will give you a king in my wrath,
and I will take him away in my indignation.
The iniquity of Ephraim has been bound;
The pains of giving birth will reach him.
nunc enim non stabit in contritione filiorum.
For now he will not remain firm during the contrition of his sons.
I will free them from the hand of death;
from death I will redeem them.
I will be your deadly wound.
consolatio abscondita est ab oculis meis.
Consolation is hidden from my eyes.
For he will make a division among brothers.
adducet urentem ventum Dominus de deserto ascendentem,
The Lord will bring a burning wind, rising up from the desert,
and it will dry up his streams,
and it will make his fountain desolate,
et ipse diripiet thesaurum omnis vasis desiderabilis.
and he will tear apart every collection of desirable useful things.
